headline: IP.com to Sponsor Webinar on Deciding What Is Worth Patenting in the AI Era
summary: IP.com will sponsor a live webinar on September 3, 2026, at 12:00 PM ET, examining the threshold decisions that AI-assisted patent drafting increasingly skips over. Produced and hosted by IPWatchdog, "Before the Draft: Deciding What Is Worth Patenting in the AI Era" brings together IP leaders, inventors, and researchers for the discussion.

headline: Supermicro's Seventh Annual Open Storage Summit Brings Together 21 Ecosystem Partners to Share Practical Guidance on Deploying Enterprise AI at Scale

(NASDAQ: SMCI), a Total IT Solution Provider for AI, Enterprise, Storage, and 5G/Edge featuring Data Center Building Block Solutions® (DCBBS), today announced the seventh annual Supermicro Open Storage Summit, a virtual event presented with theCUBE that will run from August 11 through September 3.
